@@U00018@@
I don't stoop to such things. Is this what you've come down to? Lowered your standards to the level of hackwork? A butcher’s trade?

@@U00020@@
Complain all you like, it makes no difference. What matters most in doing a job right is having the proper tools. Know the people you're writing for: it’s soft wood you have to split, not hard. One of them comes bored out of his wits, another with a belly about to burst, and worst of all, many come straight from reading the newspapers. They come to us distracted, absentmindedly, as though they were off to a masquerade, only curiosity leading them on. And the ladies, ah, the ladies, they appear decked out in all their finery, mounting their own little play, and what’s more, without pay. What are you dreaming up there in your ivory tower? Why should a full house make you happy? Take a closer look at your customers. Half are cold and the other half coarse. One looks forward after the show to a game of cards, another to a wild romp with a whore. Is it for that you torture the Muses? Ah, poor fools! My advice is pile it high as it will go,

@@U00020@@
你想抱怨什么就抱怨什么，没有什么区别。 What matters most in doing a job right is having the proper tools.了解你正在为谁写作：你必须劈开的是软木，而不是硬木。其中一个人感到无聊得快要疯了，另一个人则肚子快要撑破了，最糟糕的是，许多人是直接读完报纸而来的。 They come to us distracted, absentmindedly, as though they were off to a masquerade, only curiosity leading them on. And the ladies, ah, the ladies, they appear decked out in all their finery, mounting their own little play, and what’s more, without pay.你在象牙塔里梦想着什么？为什么满屋子会让你开心？仔细观察您的客户。一半是冷的，另一半是粗糙的。演出结束后，有人期待一场纸牌游戏，有人期待与妓女的疯狂嬉闹。你就是为了折磨缪斯女神吗？啊，可怜的傻瓜们！我的建议是尽可能把它堆高，
